headline: Building & Finance Subcommittee reviews DPW tickets, FY25 audit, special education costs, and budget transfers.
summary: The subcommittee will hear a Chief Financial Officer's report and discuss DPW tickets, the FY25 end of year report audit, special education out-of-district tuition and transportation, staffing, budget transfers, content planning, and GHS library technical issues.
items: FY25 End of Year Report Audit
Special Education - Out of District Tuition
Special Education - Out of District Transportation
location: Gloucester High School Library, 32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930
